method: Matched against the full IMDb dataset (1,28,85,817 rows, filmiset_all_world_master_15m.db). Four passes: exact normalised name; punctuation-free name; IMDb title extends ours ('Lagaan' -> 'Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India'); ours extends IMDb's ('Star Wars: Andor' -> 'Andor').

why_119_remain.stage_plays: IMDb does not catalogue theatre — Gujarati, Marathi and Bengali nataks (Ghasiram Kotwal, Tughlaq, Ashadh Ka Ek Din, Tumhari Amrita) can never match.
why_119_remain.spelling_variants: Shankarabharanam (IMDb: Sankarabharanam), Anhe Ghore Da Daan, Natasamrat.
why_119_remain.fabricated: Generic descriptive phrases in the smallest languages — 'Songs of the Himalayas', 'Chhath: The Sun Festival', 'Bodo Weaves: Dokhona'.

earlier_check: The All-Regions PDF was checked before import: 191 of 280 kept, 89 held back in curated_india_all_rejected.json.
